response.justification: Highly experienced fullstack engineer (15+ years, well beyond the 6+ requirement) with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes, plus current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) that maps precisely to the AI agent requirement. Strong engineering-craft signals: TDD, trunk-based development, CI/CD, and authored open-source test tooling. Main gaps are the absence of Nest.js and Vitest/Jest specifics, thin recent Kotlin/Java exposure, and a frontend history weighted toward Ember rather than React — all plausible to close quickly for an engineer of this breadth. Recommend interview with probing on backend framework depth and React depth.
strengths: Deep fullstack experience with TypeScript/Node, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/K8s
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling work matching a hard-to-find requirement
Exceptional testing/quality craft: TDD advocate, authored test runner and assertion libraries
concerns: No mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest by name
Kotlin/Java exposure is limited and dated (2016–2018)
Frontend depth skews Ember/legacy; React limited to one recent role

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and named testing frameworks
